item.title: Govt to recruit 10,000 new cops: Home Minister
item.description: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed has announced that 10,000 new constables will soon be recruited to strengthen law enforcement capacity. The recruitment process will begin once approval is received from the Ministry of Finance.While briefing journalists at the Secretariat, the minister made the remarks on Thursday.He stated that the government is working to increase the strength of the police force. item.title: BNP picks Badsha for Bogura-6
item.description: BNP has nominated Rezaul Karim Badsha, president of its Bogura district unit, as the party's candidate for the upcoming Bogura-6 by-election. item.title: 3 burnt as AC explodes in Narinda
item.description: Three people, including a woman, sustained burn injuries as an air conditioner (AC) exploded at a residence in Old Dhaka’s Narinda late Thursday night.The victims were admitted to the National Burn Institute, a Fire Service Headquarters source said.The fire broke out on the building’s third floor following the explosion. Firefighters rushed to the scene, but the blaze had already been brought under control.Locals took the burn victims to the hospital.

item.title: Hanging body of AIUB student recovered from Bashundhara
